candidate_audits.reason: The source paper already establishes task-order sensitivity. The valid causal extension exposed by the cheapest falsifier is the environment-history confound already materialized as the completed D5 audit paper.

candidate_audits.source_state: The financial-agent audit reports a strong descriptive association between failure-derived retrieval and persistent W->W failures, while explicitly identifying task-difficulty confounding. Transition arithmetic does not establish failure provenance as the main source of C->W regressions. No matched provenance intervention is reported.
candidate_audits.paper_level_hypothesis: Failure-derived memory provenance causally sustains persistent error beyond task difficulty and semantic memory content.

candidate_audits.source_state: The source identifies proxy LLM reward as noisy and avoids that confound by using ground-truth reward. It does not intervene on reward noise during memory construction, so the proposed reward-noise-to-memory-variance mechanism remains unrefuted.
experiment_debt: same trajectories with ground-truth reward memory construction
same trajectories with controlled proxy reward noise
downstream run-variance comparison under fixed model and order
candidate_audits.paper_level_hypothesis: Proxy reward error is written into self-improving memory and amplifies downstream run variance.

candidate_audits.source_state: TimeSage-EV reports temporal grounding failures and overall gains from reusable skill memory. It does not perform a targeted temporal/exogenous skill intervention against matched generic skills on the same endpoints.
candidate_audits.paper_level_hypothesis: Targeted temporal and exogenous-context skills causally remove persistent temporal grounding failures beyond generic skill retrieval.
